# Operations Incident Log

This document outlines critical operational tasks and monitoring requirements:

*   Investigate the branch efficiency standard update.
*   Urgently monitor customer wait times.
*   Optimize customer wait times on a quarterly basis.
*   Update branch efficiency for the 2026 strategy.
*   Monitor cash flow based on audit findings.
